title: Signal drift hunting and alert curation (WIP)
body:
Purpose and scope:
This is a working note for hunting recurring signal drift and curating noisy SLO/alert rules. Focus is on three recurring pain points we keep seeing in the last quarter: (1) bursty pager noise from transient scraping errors, (2) missing/late metrics that cause false SLO burns, and (3) flapping threshold alerts after config changes. The goal is to capture concrete short-term mitigations (on-call friendly) and longer-term fixes for the telemetry pipeline and alerting rules.

Recent incidents that motivated this doc:
- 2026-01-22: multiple SLO burn alerts for routing-service latency; root cause initially unknown, on-call saw sudden drop in "request_success_rate" metric; metric returned after ~18min and SLOs recovered. Pager fatigue across 4 teams.
- 2025-12-03: Prometheus scrape backlog due to cardinality spike from a bad exporter, causing missing histograms for 40m and a single big Pager for infra team.
- 2025-10-09: Alert flapping after rollout of new rollout policy; threshold scaling rules triggered repeatedly because queries didn't exclude internal debug labels.

Observed patterns / hypotheses:
- Missing metrics typically coincide with exporter restarts or transient IAM errors between metric shipper and the ingest cluster. The SLO rules are brittle because they assume zero missing data; when Prometheus returns NaN or no series, alert evaluators treat that as 'bad' which manifests as SLO burn.
- High-cardinality labels from recent debug logging surfaced in the exporter (label "trace_id" leaked into metrics), blowing up time-to-write and increasing scrape timeouts.
- Some alerts are too low-level and fire for upstream transient failures rather than customer-impacting signals.
- Runbook steps for metric gaps are too technical for first responders (they require deep Prometheus query knowledge).

Immediate mitigations (playbook items on-call should follow)
- If SLO burn alert fires and dashboards show a sudden drop to 0 for a success metric: 1) check exporter logs for 5xx/connection errors (grafana link in linked artifacts), 2) check Prometheus target status page for 'down' / high scrape duration, 3) check ingestion cluster metrics (rabbitmq/forwarder backlog). If exporter down, route to owning infra/telemetry on-call.
- Add a temporary "missing-data grace" window to critical SLO alerts: evaluate SLO over a 5m warmup (ignore single-evaluation drops) and require 2 consecutive evals before paging. This reduces transient pages. (Short-term rule pushed live after agreement with product SLO owners.)
- For any alert that fires due to NaN/no-series in query results, convert query to explicitly treat missing as 'no-change' where safe: e.g. use coalesce/OR patterns to default to last-known value or to exclude series with absent data.

Longer-term fixes / engineering action items
- Telemetry: add server-side validation on exported metric label keys (block label keys matching known debug patterns like "trace_id", "session_uuid") and emit a metric about rejected label cardinality. Owner: telemetry infra (Mateo). ETA: 2026-03-15.
- Ingestion: add a heartbeat synthetic that verifies the metric ingestion pipeline end-to-end every 30s and surfaces a single synthetic metric (ingest_healthy{env=prod}). Tie SLO/alert rules to this synthetic where appropriate. Owner: infra-observability (Hana). ETA: 2026-04-01.
- Alerting: review and group low-level infra alerts into meta-alerts with runbook links; for every alert evaluate whether it should page, email, or log only. Create an "alert criticality matrix" doc to standardize. Owner: eng-sre. ETA: 2026-03-01.
- SLO evaluation semantics: default to treating missing-series as unknown rather than fail for product-facing SLOs. This requires updating the evaluation engine config and notifying product owners. Owner: platform-engineering. ETA: 2026-05-01.

Runbook draft (quick steps for the first 15 minutes)
1) Acknowledge the page and post to #sre-oncall with incident id, brief symptom.
2) Quick triage (5 mins): - Are customer facing metrics down across multiple regions? if yes -> treat as high severity and follow outage runbook. - If only a single metric dropped to 0 but request traces look healthy -> likely telemetry gap.
3) Telemetry checks (5 mins): - open Prometheus > /targets and look for target failures; - check exporter pod restarts (kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=exporter); - check forwarder write-latency (ingest_forwarder_latency_ms).
4) Mitigation options (10 mins): - If exporter restart is the cause, restart with new image if available or scale to 0/1 to flush stuck sockets. - If cardinality explosion suspected: temporarily drop the exporter scrape (blackhole) to reduce load and notify dev team; create a ticket for label cleanup. - If query result is NaN because Prometheus returned no series: silence the SLO alert channel for 20m and set a follow-up to validate ingestion.
5) Post-mitigation: confirm SLO returns to normal for 30m before closing the page. Schedule a follow-up postmortem if customer impact was observed.

Open questions / tradeoffs:
- How aggressive should we be in treating missing data as non-failure? Too permissive and we risk masking real outages. Need product input on which SLOs are allowed to have 'unknown' evaluations.
- Grace windows reduce noise but can delay detection; propose per-SLO grace windows based on historical distribution of transient blips (we can compute percentile of transient drops).
- Budget for synthetic checks: more synthetics give better coverage but increase cost and maintenance.

Follow-ups and owners (short list)
- telemetry: add label-key blacklist and metric about rejections — Mateo (ETA 2026-03-15)
- infra-observability: implement ingest_healthy synthetic and dashboard — Hana (ETA 2026-04-01)
- eng-sre: audit top 50 alert rules for flapping and set paging thresholds — Jonah (ETA 2026-03-01)
- product: decide per-SLO policy for missing-data semantics — assigned product SLO owners (ask in next SLO sync)

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is conversational and intentionally rough. I want a small triage checklist that any new on-call can run in 5–10 minutes, plus a prioritized set of engineering tasks. Please add concrete queries or links to dashboards where you think they'd help (I left placeholders to keep this doc compact).
- If you think some fixes are too invasive for short-term, mark them and propose an alternative.

Recent related tickets: JIRA-SRE-987 (investigate SLO burns 2026-01-22), JIRA-TEL-312 (exporter high cardinality), GITHUB-421 (prometheus query change to avoid NaN semantics).

Unresolved TODOs:
- Flesh out exact PromQL snippets for 'missing-data' tolerant queries and add to runbook.
- Create the alert criticality matrix and link to the rule audit checklist.
- Schedule a cross-team postmortem for 2026-01-22 incident (tentative: 2026-02-21).

-- Aisha
